lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Why is Syuen so hell-bent

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: on finding Chatterbox anyway?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It doesn't make any sense.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Maybe she wants to use Chatterbox as a reference for new Nikke designs?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: No, I don't think so.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: It's been proven that Rapture technology is incompatible with Nikkes.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Well, now I'm really curious.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You look like you know something.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: She probably considers it a notch in her belt.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: A what in her what?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Missilis has always been the largest of the Big Three.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: However, compared to her predecessor, the company has been somewhat scaled back since Syuen took over.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Meanwhile, Elysion and Tetra Line have continued making new advances and closing the gap between them and Missilis.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: In other words, Syuen is resting on her laurels.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Now I get it.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Syuen wants to prove herself.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You think that's why she treats us and the Nikkes from Wardress the way she does?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Most likely.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Shouldn't she just focus more on Nikke R&D?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Why send a team she's not familiar with up to the surface?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Every organization in the Ark is vying for all the currently existing resources.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Sooner or later, that competition will inevitably extend to the surface.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: How should I put this...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I feel like Syuen is rushing into things.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: As far as I know,

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: she's a genius who's adept at developing all sorts of new technologies.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: She's also loaded.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Sure, but running a company is an entirely different beast.
Let's wait and see how this unfolds.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: After all, it's not like we have anything else to do right now.
